scope: Same 202 original entry points and 50 named additions as revision 4, remapped under user review decisions; no new repository census

mappings.name: poteto-mode
mappings.retain: Task routing, accountable supervision, engineering principles, and deliberate delegation.
mappings.change: Remove the sticky personal mode as a prerequisite. Put routing in lead, common constraints in rules, procedures in their owners, and personal prose preferences outside global engineering guidance.

mappings.name: how
mappings.retain: Trace an actual subsystem, then explain its working model.
mappings.change: Locating and analysis go through research; human-facing teaching goes through explain. No separate how command or mandatory explainer subprocess for a small question.

mappings.name: why
mappings.retain: Investigate rationale using code history and relevant external records; distinguish fact from inference.
mappings.change: Select sources by the question instead of always dispatching seven investigators. Return preserve/change/avoid constraints when the answer will guide a modification.

mappings.name: recall
mappings.retain: Reconstruct recent work from transcripts, shared records, and live code/PR state.
mappings.change: Recall is the pickup branch of handoff, backed by research. No new personal-memory service or host-specific transcript layout in the reusable procedure.

mappings.name: blast-radius
mappings.retain: Inspect dependencies beyond textual callers and identify the assumptions that make a change safe.
mappings.change: Keep this as a review lens and verification obligation. A small diff does not imply a small impact; unproven safety assumptions remain open.

mappings.name: architect
mappings.retain: Sketch usage, types, interfaces, ownership, and alternatives before a consequential implementation.
mappings.change: Keep architecture and plausible alternatives together. Design returns a design; the delivery owner continues implementation. Structural friction can require an in-scope redesign rather than another patch. Full clean PR replacement remains the user-requested manual rewrite, not an architect side effect.

mappings.name: arena
mappings.retain: Generate independent candidates, compare against criteria, choose a coherent base, and inspect useful ideas from other candidates.
mappings.change: Combine arena and swarm into the reusable model-invokable swarm skill, also available for manual use. Compare mode owns independent candidates, coherent base selection, compatible grafts, and re-verification; no fixed model roster.

mappings.name: swarm
mappings.retain: Declare partition or race, isolate outputs, collect every required result, and expose gaps.
mappings.change: Combine with arena under swarm. Partition mode keeps complete-coverage semantics distinct from competing attempts. Procedures refer to this skill; no separate execution-strategy concept or runtime is added.

mappings.name: interrogate
mappings.retain: Independent adversarial review followed by evidence-based adjudication of agreement, dissent, and false positives.
mappings.change: Use reviewer instances and optional lenses; preserve report-only semantics. No automatic edits or weight-by-majority rule.

mappings.name: automate-me
mappings.retain: Extract repeated working preferences from scoped evidence and the user’s explicit choices.
mappings.change: Write approved instructions at their proper home rather than manufacture a personal -mode skill or require a PR for every preference.

mappings.name: make-bot-ui
mappings.retain: Keep the narrow lessons about server-side secrets, fixed external targets, and treating webhook payloads as data.
mappings.change: Do not build a Grok Bot webhook UI, install Tailscale, or carry its endpoints into the reusable stack. That is a separate application project.

mappings.name: setup-pstack
mappings.retain: Choose available models once for named responsibilities rather than per-task user selection.
mappings.change: Write model choices in agent definitions. Do not preserve pstack-models.mdc, its roster, or introduce a registry/routing service. Configure the twelve definitions individually; the added assignments provide task-specific cost/performance control without a profile registry.

mappings.name: reflect
mappings.retain: Review real session evidence, distinguish reusable learning from noise, and prefer structural fixes.
mappings.change: Fold reflection into model-invokable compound. Inspect real feedback and propose a focused edit; an explicit user edit request authorizes immediate scoped application without a second approval. Inferred patterns require approval before active guidance changes.

mappings.name: teach
mappings.retain: Combine mechanisms and rationale into an explanation appropriate to what the person needs to understand.
mappings.change: Keep ordinary explanation and an optional visual walkthrough; remove mandatory diagram counts, conversational theater, and a separate teaching agent.

mappings.name: tdd
mappings.retain: Use a faithful regression case before a fix when requested or practical; report the substitute when a durable test is impractical.
mappings.change: Retain pragmatic test choice. Test-first is not mandatory for every edit, and skipping a new test does not mean skipping verification.

mappings.name: no-comments
mappings.retain: Investigate comments that compensate for weak names, types, design, or missing enforcement.
mappings.change: Remove delete-on-doubt, automatic comment deletion before agreement, and the dedicated persona. Preserve useful rationale until its replacement is actually in place.

mappings.name: typescript-best-practices
mappings.retain: Typed domain states, honest boundary parsing, exhaustive variants, and schema-derived shapes.
mappings.change: Universal ideas belong in principles. TypeScript idioms stay in language-specific sections/project conventions; no global ban on every cast or mandatory object parameters.

mappings.name: figure-it-out
mappings.retain: Design a task-specific sequence, establish evidence first, work uncertain units, and retain a decision trail.
mappings.change: No bespoke-playbook generator as a separate user concept. Plan supplies the task sequence; deliver executes it with scoped rules.

mappings.name: show-me-your-work
mappings.retain: One work-and-decision log kept during execution, evidence pointers, meaningful failed attempts, independent trail audit, and a human-readable PR artifact.
mappings.change: Adopt this pattern as the default for substantive delivery. The lead is the single log writer; isolated workers return decision entries. Publish a durable redacted log and confidence-graded audit on the PR. Grade evidential support rather than invent numerical confidence, and bind claims to code revisions.

mappings.name: create-verification-skill
mappings.retain: Discover launch/drive/observe/cleanup instructions, create a project recipe, and prove it works end-to-end.
mappings.change: Generate a project-local verify-<project> skill only when needed. This is a concrete project skill, not a new adapter category.

mappings.name: maintain-verification-skill
mappings.retain: Reconcile the feature map with source and real execution while keeping product regressions separate from documentation drift.
mappings.change: Use setup’s repair branch. Do not require one worker per feature or silently edit product code to make the map look correct.

mappings.name: unslop
mappings.retain: Remove filler, vague attribution, unnecessary jargon, formulaic repetition, and over-compressed prose.
mappings.change: Preserve informative caveats and natural writing. Universal bans on punctuation or individual words are personal taste, not global rules.

mappings.name: bro
mappings.retain: Re-express an answer that the person could not understand.
mappings.change: A rephrase trigger on explain replaces a separate corrective command. Keep the substance rather than merely shortening the response.

mappings.name: technical-writing
mappings.retain: Write for the document’s purpose, use concrete terms and instructions, and keep grammar unambiguous.
mappings.change: Use shared writing guidance and local PR/instruction references. Do not impose one rigid document taxonomy or punctuation regimen on every artifact.

mappings.name: principle-attack-the-premise
mappings.retain: Repeated failures can implicate a shared premise.
mappings.change: Keep premise testing; an actor-imbalance census and role rotation are examples, not a universal debugging prescription.

mappings.name: principle-boundary-discipline
mappings.retain: Validate at trust boundaries and keep domain logic distinct from framework wiring.
mappings.change: Replace unconditional trust in all internal code with justified invariants; runtime race, corruption, and external-state checks can still be necessary.

mappings.name: principle-build-the-lever
mappings.retain: Build small repeatable scripts or generators that make work and verification reproducible.
mappings.change: Use when useful; no rule that every nontrivial task must produce a new tool or committed helper.

mappings.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
mappings.retain: Convert recurring constraints into stronger mechanisms rather than repeated reminders.
mappings.change: Do not silently expand a code task into global instruction or toolchain changes.

mappings.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
mappings.retain: Explore materially different candidates when a consequential choice is genuinely open.
mappings.change: Not a universal principle file or mandatory two-candidate gate for routine code.

mappings.name: principle-experience-first
mappings.retain: Choose by user and maintainer outcomes rather than implementation convenience.
mappings.change: Remove delight rhetoric as a universal criterion; reliability, access, and correctness can be the relevant experience.

mappings.name: principle-fix-root-causes
mappings.retain: Reproduce, instrument, and remove the failure mechanism.
mappings.change: A nil check can be the correct boundary fix; reject symptom masking by evidence, not by syntax.

mappings.name: principle-foundational-thinking
mappings.retain: Choose useful data structures, ownership, and shared foundations before dependent work.
mappings.change: No blanket scaffold-first mandate when a small vertical probe would reveal the right foundation.

mappings.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
mappings.retain: Keep bulk exploration away from the coordinating conversation and retain relevant pointers.
mappings.change: Do not require summaries in place of all primary evidence or declare a universal safe token threshold.

mappings.name: principle-laziness-protocol
mappings.retain: Prefer the smallest adequate solution, eliminate pass-through layers, and question gratuitous signal threading.
mappings.change: No universal three-file depth limit or assumption that fewer lines always means lower complexity.

mappings.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
mappings.retain: Handle retries and partial completion without duplicating effects; reconcile actual state.
mappings.change: Keep as applicable coding/procedure guidance, not a requirement for a new controller or a claim that every operation can be made idempotent by prose.

mappings.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
mappings.retain: Retire an old internal API after all controlled consumers move.
mappings.change: Atomic migration is one branch; stored data, external clients, and rolling deployments may require compatibility stages.

mappings.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
mappings.retain: Reduce indirection and hidden/mutable state that a reader must track.
mappings.change: Keep the design criterion, not a universal thirty-second comprehension test.

mappings.name: principle-model-the-domain
mappings.retain: Use appropriate structures for states, relationships, access patterns, and ownership.
mappings.change: Do not force a state machine, registry, or named abstraction when local code already expresses the concept clearly.

mappings.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
mappings.retain: Proceed on authorized reversible execution and consult the human for intent.
mappings.change: Reversibility alone is not authorization, especially for messages, spending, and external state.

mappings.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
mappings.retain: Allow planned temporary local breakage where a coordinated migration needs it.
mappings.change: Deployed or independently merged states still need their promised compatibility; never use end-state language to excuse unverified intermediate publication.

mappings.name: principle-prove-it-works
mappings.retain: Inspect the real result rather than infer success from agent self-report.
mappings.change: Verification level follows the claim; a library need not have a UI to be verifiable.

mappings.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
mappings.retain: Reconsider the shape when a new requirement invalidates the old assumptions.
mappings.change: Think broadly but edit within authorized scope; not a license to rewrite adjacent systems.

mappings.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
mappings.retain: Avoid unnecessary shared writes, otherwise coordinate a genuine shared resource.
mappings.change: Separate worktrees do not isolate shared databases, ports, browser state, or semantically coupled contracts.

mappings.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
mappings.retain: Use coherent increments and a sequence whose results can be checked.
mappings.change: Do not require separately merging a knowingly failing regression-test commit; red-before-green can be preserved as evidence within a green deliverable.

mappings.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
mappings.retain: Remove obsolete structure before extending it when that reduces complexity.
mappings.change: Subtraction is not always the safe first migration step; compatibility obligations can require expansion first.

mappings.name: principle-test-behavior-not-implementation
mappings.retain: Use tests sensitive to actual defects and expected results independent of the implementation.
mappings.change: Do not keep the literal-only rule or the inaccurate claim that every listed weak assertion would pass an undefined-return mutation. Negative tests and properties can be valuable.

mappings.name: principle-type-system-discipline
mappings.retain: Represent valid states, preserve type truth, and derive types from their authoritative definitions.
mappings.change: Language details are scoped references. Static types do not prove all runtime, concurrency, or security properties.

mappings.name: authoring-a-skill
mappings.retain: Write focused agent instructions, validate references, and try useful examples.
mappings.change: No separate authoring playbook or mandatory PR for every personal edit.

mappings.name: autonomous-run
mappings.retain: Drive an authorized task toward a checkable outcome and preserve progress.
mappings.change: Bound the run and return a checkpoint when necessary. No invented loop scheduling or refusal to stop at a real budget limit. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: autopilot-full
mappings.retain: Independent change owners, review separation, and fresh evidence before authorized landing.
mappings.change: The lead remains the canonical integration owner; no new owner/root role hierarchy or fixed audit heartbeat. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: autopilot-stack
mappings.retain: Build dependent changes with explicit topology and stop before landing when the user retains that authority.
mappings.change: One delivery procedure with a stack branch, not a second autopilot system. Reassess changed-base behavior beyond patch equivalence. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: babysit
mappings.retain: Separate check, feedback-only, and sustained follow-through; stop at readiness.
mappings.change: Keep modes as ordinary request interpretation. Do not import a forge-specific watcher protocol or automatically merge. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: bug-fix
mappings.retain: Reproduce, diagnose, fix, and verify the original symptom.
mappings.change: Repair is an entry branch of deliver with stronger pre-fix evidence, not a duplicate full delivery tail. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: eval
mappings.retain: Compare comparable tasks with criteria and optional blinded reviewers; inspect actual outcomes.
mappings.change: Blinding is useful for a comparison, but no universal ban on words in ordinary work directories or requirement to inspect every transcript.

mappings.name: feature
mappings.retain: Ground the outcome, design as needed, delegate bounded implementation, review, and verify.
mappings.change: Remove mandatory architecture fan-out for every function-boundary change and routine delegation for trivial edits. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: hillclimb
mappings.retain: Maintain a target, baseline, hypotheses, keep/revert decisions, and regression constraints.
mappings.change: No mandatory minimum number of experiments after the target is met; stop according to useful evidence and the agreed budget.

mappings.name: investigation
mappings.retain: Read-only investigation ending in an explanation or recommendation.
mappings.change: No standalone playbook when research plus explain is sufficient; no PR creation tail.

mappings.name: multi-phase-plan
mappings.retain: Describe units, dependencies, verification, and operator-owned decisions.
mappings.change: Remove the mandatory ten live lanes, fixed model, rigid plan template, and per-change performance proof when no performance claim exists. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: opening-a-pr
mappings.retain: Focused changes, reviewable history, concise intent and evidence, and explicit PR creation.
mappings.change: Open draft or ready according to actual state. Babysitting only follows when requested, not by accidental command composition. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite. A PR URL is an intermediate result for full delivery; the final endpoint is current-head merge-ready with a linked audit and decision log.

mappings.name: orchestrate
mappings.retain: Clear briefs, owned units, real dependencies, result reconciliation, and integration throughout work.
mappings.change: No controller CLI, persistent state machine, fixed hierarchy, Graphite dependency, cloud fleet, or timer implementation in this Markdown stack. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: pause-safely
mappings.retain: Stop cleanly and preserve the next resumption point.
mappings.change: No unconditional WIP commit or cancellation of work the current task does not own.

mappings.name: perf-issue
mappings.retain: Measure the realistic workload, attribute cost, apply a supported change, and measure again.
mappings.change: Diagnosis stays separate from a repeated optimization campaign; eight strategy families are hypothesis prompts, not required experiments.

mappings.name: prototype
mappings.retain: Use an isolated throwaway experiment to settle a design question.
mappings.change: Keep the tested dimension real, even when a visual judgment requires polish. A prototype is not always a vanilla-HTML page.

mappings.name: refactoring
mappings.retain: Pin behavior, choose the desired shape, make coherent moves, and prove equivalence.
mappings.change: Preserve the refactor-specific contract inside deliver; no prohibition on justified transitional compatibility. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: runtime-forensics
mappings.retain: Capture and inspect live runtime evidence, then map the mechanism to source.
mappings.change: A diagnosis-only task may authorize probes but not a fix. Live evaluation/hotpatching is not automatically read-only or permitted.

mappings.name: session-pickup
mappings.retain: Locate the prior trail and resume from its actual state rather than redoing all work.
mappings.change: Reconcile consequential claims with current evidence; neither blanket trust nor a full restart is appropriate.

mappings.name: shipping
mappings.retain: Independent evidence, explicit merge authority, and bottom-up landing of a verified dependent prefix.
mappings.change: Retain no promise that an unchanged patch-id preserves all behavioral assurance after a base change. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: trace-forensics
mappings.retain: Analyze a capture already supplied, reduce it to relevant frames/retainers, and map findings to source.
mappings.change: Do not turn captured-trace analysis into a mandatory new capture. Without causal evidence or a valid paired capture, retain hypothesis status.

mappings.name: visual-parity
mappings.retain: Capture a controlled baseline, migrate coherently, and compare the actual rendered outputs.
mappings.change: Tolerance is agreed and environment-dependent; pixel-diff zero is an optional exact requirement, not the universal default.

mappings.name: worktree-cleanup
mappings.retain: Inventory resources and confirm that work is merged, preserved, and no longer active before deletion.
mappings.change: Do not classify all untracked files as disposable or bake iOS cleanup commands into every project.

mappings.name: setup-benny
mappings.retain: Explicit source identity, target configuration, model availability, and capability checks.
mappings.change: No Benny installation or Slack automation creation in core. These become project setup instructions only for a project that requests them.

mappings.name: triage-issue-reports
mappings.retain: Full-report reading, cause-aware routing, deduplication, fixed source coordinates, and one accountable external writer.
mappings.change: Keep source-local rules when using that integration. Do not carry marker strings, user IDs, fixed channels, or compensation APIs into global guidance.

mappings.name: reproduce-and-fix-issues
mappings.retain: Check existing ownership/fix artifacts, reproduce the exact symptom, bound the repair, and require before/after evidence.
mappings.change: No separate automation runtime. Use an explicit number of repetitions appropriate to the failure, not always two; draft publication follows the actual request.

mappings.name: check-compiler-errors
mappings.retain: Run project compile/type checks and group actionable failures.
mappings.change: Known commands run directly; fixes go through integrate rather than silently extending verification.

mappings.name: control-cli
mappings.retain: Reuse a real CLI/TUI harness, deterministic input/readiness, transcripts, and clean teardown.
mappings.change: Project-specific PTY/tmux commands live in the local verification recipe, not a new global control role.

mappings.name: control-ui
mappings.retain: Stable page targeting, fresh state between actions, real interaction, and visible evidence.
mappings.change: Use the available approved browser/app tools and project recipe; no mandatory CDP implementation or additional tooling installation.

mappings.name: deslop
mappings.retain: Remove unnecessary comments, casts, defensive ceremony, and local inconsistency in the current change.
mappings.change: Check that apparently redundant code is actually unnecessary; preserve behavior and security.

mappings.name: fix-ci
mappings.retain: Read failed PR checks, inspect the real error, apply a focused fix, and rerun.
mappings.change: Push only with inherited authority. Classify external, flaky, stale, and code failures separately.

mappings.name: fix-merge-conflicts
mappings.retain: Resolve conflicts and regenerate generated artifacts using their owning tools.
mappings.change: Compilation is not enough to choose between incompatible intents; surface consequential ambiguity.

mappings.name: get-pr-comments
mappings.retain: Fetch all relevant feedback surfaces and produce actionable dispositions.
mappings.change: Retrieval is a step, not its own global skill or separate agent type.

mappings.name: loop-on-ci
mappings.retain: Watch actual PR-attached checks and refresh after each push.
mappings.change: Use bounded supported watching; do not confuse GitHub Actions-only history with all PR checks.

mappings.name: make-pr-easy-to-review
mappings.retain: Separate mechanical from conceptual changes and provide a useful reviewer entry point.
mappings.change: History rewriting requires explicit authority and content equivalence checks; reviewability does not authorize behavior changes.

mappings.name: new-branch-and-pr
mappings.retain: Work on an owned branch, implement and check a change, then open the requested PR.
mappings.change: Delivery and publication are composed rather than duplicated into another full-stack command. A PR URL is an intermediate result for full delivery; the final endpoint is current-head merge-ready with a linked audit and decision log.

mappings.name: pr-review-canvas
mappings.retain: Provide a navigable walkthrough of the actual diff and its core versus mechanical changes.
mappings.change: HTML is an optional artifact format; no fixed dark theme, port, or vendor-specific renderer in core.

mappings.name: review-and-ship
mappings.retain: Review intent, regressions, and tests before requested publication.
mappings.change: Use the same review and ship definitions; do not bypass independent review by renaming it a shipping recap. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite. A PR URL is an intermediate result for full delivery; the final endpoint is current-head merge-ready with a linked audit and decision log.

mappings.name: run-smoke-tests
mappings.retain: Run the real smoke suite, inspect traces, and retest defects.
mappings.change: Verification reports; authorized repair returns to integrate/implement rather than changing scope silently.

mappings.name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
mappings.retain: Look for structural simplification, clean ownership/type boundaries, fewer special cases, and unnecessary wrappers.
mappings.change: Keep an ambitious structural review lens and give simplification its own model assignment. A further implementation pass is normal when it produces a simpler robust design; file-size numbers and deletion counts are not universal acceptance criteria. No automatic full PR rewrite.

mappings.name: verify-this
mappings.retain: State a falsifiable claim and compare comparable baseline and treatment artifacts.
mappings.change: Use supported/refuted/inconclusive outcomes without demanding a relative baseline for every new feature.

mappings.name: weekly-review
mappings.retain: Summarize substantive authored work in a named time interval.
mappings.change: One recap branch handles arbitrary dates; no separate weekly versus custom-range commands.

mappings.name: what-did-i-get-done
mappings.retain: Ground an activity recap in actual changes and the requested date range.
mappings.change: Do not count uncommitted or merely discussed work as shipped; retain only relevant detail.

mappings.name: workflow-from-chats
mappings.retain: Extract repeated preferences with evidence, distinguish uncertainty, and filter anecdotes.
mappings.change: Choose the correct role/rule/procedure home instead of creating a workflow document for every preference.

mappings.name: ce-babysit-pr
mappings.retain: Current-state snapshots, feedback before obsolete CI repair, single-writer work, and explicit residual decisions.
mappings.change: Move stack landing to ship. No bundled snapshot engine or custom status vocabulary is required; retain truthful current-head readiness. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: ce-brainstorm
mappings.retain: Settle WHAT, right-size discovery, and avoid re-asking decisions already made.
mappings.change: Requirements and HOW can share one plan with clear sections; remove repeated artifact-root/config protocols.

mappings.name: ce-code-review
mappings.retain: Independent, risk-driven review with report-only behavior and deliberate application of findings.
mappings.change: Represent personas as criteria references. No default external peer disclosure unless the user’s model/context sharing scope permits it.

mappings.name: ce-commit-push-pr
mappings.retain: Focused publication, fresh remote-state checks, and grounded PR descriptions.
mappings.change: No automatic babysitter unless follow-through was requested; keep commit, push, PR, and merge authority distinct. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite. A PR URL is an intermediate result for full delivery; the final endpoint is current-head merge-ready with a linked audit and decision log.

mappings.name: ce-commit
mappings.retain: Commit named files and protect unrelated staged changes.
mappings.change: Local commit is a ship endpoint, not another reusable skill. Follow the project’s conventions rather than impose a universal feat/fix preference.

mappings.name: ce-compound-refresh
mappings.retain: Check accuracy, overlap, contradiction, and retrieval value of recorded learning.
mappings.change: Share one learning skill; pruning still-accurate knowledge is an explicit choice. Do not overwrite normative guidance to match regressed code.

mappings.name: ce-compound
mappings.retain: Only preserve verified non-obvious reasoning whose loss would cause recurrence or expensive rediscovery.
mappings.change: Keep the admission bar but not a mandatory one-learning-per-invocation or large researcher pipeline.

mappings.name: ce-debug
mappings.retain: Faithful feedback, falsifiable hypotheses, and evidence-backed fixes.
mappings.change: Diagnosis is its own skill; actual repair uses the repair branch of deliver.

mappings.name: ce-doc-review
mappings.retain: Review an existing requirements document, plan, or specification with relevant criteria.
mappings.change: Artifact type selects the lens; no separate doc reviewer role or review procedure.

mappings.name: ce-dogfood
mappings.retain: Exercise real user flows and judge the experience against intended use.
mappings.change: An exploratory-QA branch may discover issues; verify itself does not silently fix them. Accepted repairs return to implement.

mappings.name: ce-explain
mappings.retain: Use an enduring visual explanation when the subject merits one.
mappings.change: Ordinary Q&A stays in chat; no mandatory teaching artifact or distinct explain model profile.

mappings.name: ce-handoff
mappings.retain: Save or reconstruct work so a fresh session can continue.
mappings.change: One continuation skill owns create, recall, and pickup; do not duplicate saved artifacts.

mappings.name: ce-ideate
mappings.retain: Generate grounded ideas before committing to a direction.
mappings.change: Keep ideation as its own skill and multi-step pipeline: ground, diverge, evaluate, hand back. Architectural design and its local alternatives remain in design; ideation no longer lives as a branch there.

mappings.name: ce-optimize
mappings.retain: Measurement-first optimization, bounded experiments, regression constraints, and keep/revert decisions.
mappings.change: Use lightweight project artifacts; a new spec schema and dedicated experiment engine are not required.

mappings.name: ce-plan
mappings.retain: Enrich settled requirements into an executable path and preserve readiness/settled decisions.
mappings.change: Use concise local rules and plain readiness labels; remove large mandatory reference/handoff-menu mechanics.

mappings.name: ce-polish
mappings.retain: Let the user drive refinement of a working feature through actual interaction.
mappings.change: Keep human-directed polish distinct from autonomous QA; it is a delivery branch, not a separate agent personality.

mappings.name: ce-pov
mappings.retain: Give a grounded judgment on a proposed approach and form an independent view before consulting peers.
mappings.change: Use design’s assessment branch. No special verdict command, fixed grading vocabulary, or obligatory panel. The optional alternatives entry point handles an explicit rethink of an existing system; normal architectural alternatives remain inside design.

mappings.name: ce-product-pulse
mappings.retain: Use real metrics, explicit time windows, known ingestion lag, and privacy-aware summaries.
mappings.change: No fixed pulse template, cadence, or product-analytics integration in the coding core; add project instructions only when requested.

mappings.name: ce-promote
mappings.retain: Draft from the actual user-facing change and keep drafting separate from posting.
mappings.change: No marketing skill, Spiral integration, login flow, or channel-specific campaign rules in core.

mappings.name: ce-proof
mappings.retain: Preserve canonical local content, verify external writes, and protect collaboration credentials.
mappings.change: Proof is an editor service, not evidence verification. Do not build its client or duplicate owner-token rules in the core.

mappings.name: ce-prototype
mappings.retain: Choose fidelity by the decision; do not fake the dimension the person is judging.
mappings.change: Empirical technical experiments may run unattended; experiential acceptance still needs a human. Keep prototype code separate from the real build.

mappings.name: ce-resolve-pr-feedback
mappings.retain: Judge feedback centrally, apply accepted fixes, and preserve needs-human items without blocking independent work.
mappings.change: No automatic acceptance of nits or bot verdicts. Repeated non-converging advice triggers a design decision, not endless churn.

mappings.name: ce-retune
mappings.retain: Measure instruction changes, distinguish real improvement from noise, and preserve intentional human stops.
mappings.change: Do not require a benchmark harness, archive, build selector, preregistered run count, or A/A test for ordinary maintenance. Retain those as optional stronger comparisons.

mappings.name: ce-riffrec-feedback-analysis
mappings.retain: Translate recordings into attributable bug and requirement evidence.
mappings.change: Keep raw media private and reference specific moments; Riffrec setup/analyzer integration is project-specific, not core.

mappings.name: ce-setup
mappings.retain: Discover the actual project’s conventions, dependencies, and missing capabilities.
mappings.change: Do not carry CE config keys, generated examples, optional product integrations, or a new health-check engine into the stack.

mappings.name: ce-simplify-code
mappings.retain: Apply reuse, quality, and efficiency checks while preserving behavior and scoped structural decisions.
mappings.change: Adopt the behavior-preserving structure/reuse/quality/efficiency pass as a default assessment after substantive implementation and after material fix-loop churn. A dedicated simplifier is configurable; fixed three-agent fan-out is optional.

mappings.name: ce-strategy
mappings.retain: Explicit purpose, intended users, constraints, and success criteria guide downstream work.
mappings.change: Keep existing STRATEGY.md when the project has it; no obligatory strategy interview or extra core artifact template.

mappings.name: ce-sweep
mappings.retain: Bounded intake, dedupe, evidence analysis, verified fix references, and honest progress tracking.
mappings.change: No sweep state engine, lease implementation, or source-side writes by default. Scheduling stays in the existing host.

mappings.name: ce-test-browser
mappings.retain: Exercise affected routes and record pass/fail/skip for every selected route.
mappings.change: Use an approved available browser recipe; do not universalize the source’s two-driver restriction.

mappings.name: ce-test-xcode
mappings.retain: Capture actual simulator build, interaction, console, and unavailable-flow evidence.
mappings.change: Native app instructions are a project-local recipe; no iOS-specific global role or mandatory Xcode dependency.

mappings.name: ce-work
mappings.retain: Execute a clear unit with local verification and return to the caller when another workflow owns shipping.
mappings.change: Keep the child-return boundary; drop cross-model controller transactions and engine registry protocols. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: ce-worktree
mappings.retain: Create or attach an isolated workspace with exact branch and ownership identity.
mappings.change: Workspace preparation is part of setup/delivery, not an additional core concept.

mappings.name: lfg
mappings.retain: Compose planning, implementation, quality, publication, and requested follow-through under an explicit hands-off request.
mappings.change: No separate autonomous shipping copy. The delivery endpoint and authorization select the existing ship/babysit tail. Full delivery now defaults to merge-ready including review/fix, CI follow-through, and PR decision audit; it does not merge or run the optional full rewrite.

mappings.name: ask-matt
mappings.retain: Route natural-language situations to the right procedure and choose a sensible phase boundary.
mappings.change: No separate router command. The conversational lead owns routing automatically; context reset choices live with handoff.

mappings.name: grill-with-docs
mappings.retain: Run the same interview while keeping glossary and consequential decisions current.
mappings.change: One clarify skill invokes model when needed. Recording is conditional behavior, not another grilling implementation.

mappings.name: triage
mappings.retain: Verify incoming claims, check existing implementation and prior rejection, and produce a justified disposition or agent-ready brief.
mappings.change: Use existing tracker states and preserve source context. No mandatory label taxonomy, extra interview for ready tickets, or automatic publication beyond authority.

mappings.name: improve-codebase-architecture
mappings.retain: Find real architectural friction, especially in frequently changing code, then examine a selected deepening opportunity.
mappings.change: Structural review identifies candidates; design handles a chosen one. HTML reports and mandatory interviewing are optional. The optional alternatives entry point handles an explicit rethink of an existing system; normal architectural alternatives remain inside design.

mappings.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
mappings.retain: Inspect and record tracker conventions, terminology locations, and existing project instructions.
mappings.change: Reuse existing docs; no mandatory label taxonomy, extra bootstrap command, or duplicate CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

mappings.name: to-spec
mappings.retain: Synthesize established intent, non-goals, test decisions, and agreed implementation choices from conversation.
mappings.change: Do not restart the interview. Avoid mandatory exhaustive user-story lists; publish only when tracker writes are authorized.

mappings.name: to-tickets
mappings.retain: Make self-contained vertical units with genuine blocking edges and explicit expand–migrate–contract exceptions.
mappings.change: Ticket breakdown is the decomposition branch of plan. Native tracker links are optional storage, not another semantic layer.

mappings.name: implement
mappings.retain: Build from the specified unit with meaningful tests and a review before completion.
mappings.change: Split the unit-editing capability from the delivery tail. Do not unconditionally commit to whatever branch happens to be current.

mappings.name: wayfinder
mappings.retain: Distinguish decision tickets from build tickets and progressively specify a large uncertain effort.
mappings.change: Keep a decision frontier inside discovery/planning; no universal 100k-token ticket size, single-ticket-per-session rule, or mandatory tracker UI.

mappings.name: prototype
mappings.retain: Use throwaway logic or UI to settle a concrete question, then preserve the decision and useful evidence.
mappings.change: Keep relevant fidelity instead of a blanket no-polish rule. A specific throwaway branch/HTML format is not required.

mappings.name: diagnosing-bugs
mappings.retain: Build and tighten a faithful red-capable loop, minimize where useful, test ranked hypotheses, and return to the original scenario.
mappings.change: A fixed three-to-five hypothesis count and fully minimal repro are not prerequisites for every bug. Report unavailable evidence rather than invent a loop.

mappings.name: research
mappings.retain: Use primary sources and preserve consequential findings with citations.
mappings.change: Use background execution only when supported and useful; a new agent and a saved note are not mandatory for a small lookup.

mappings.name: tdd
mappings.retain: Prefer behavior through meaningful seams, independent expected results, and one red–green slice at a time.
mappings.change: Consult the user only when seam selection is consequential. Keep simplification separate after settled behavior, while allowing tiny local cleanup when it does not distract from the test loop.

mappings.name: domain-modeling
mappings.retain: Challenge overloaded terms, test concrete scenarios, reconcile code and meaning, and capture costly-to-reverse decisions sparingly.
mappings.change: Keep glossary and decision purpose distinct without mandating a universal file layout or renaming every code symbol.

mappings.name: codebase-design
mappings.retain: Design deep modules with useful interfaces, meaningful seams, and local reasoning; compare distinct interface alternatives.
mappings.change: Architecture vocabulary is a design reference, not a separate always-discoverable skill. Do not ban common words such as API or service globally. The optional alternatives entry point handles an explicit rethink of an existing system; normal architectural alternatives remain inside design.

mappings.name: code-review
mappings.retain: Keep Standards and Spec as distinct review axes and give independent reviewers evidence and clear criteria.
mappings.change: Use reviewer with selected lenses and reviewer-second when an additional independent model is warranted. The Standards and Spec axes remain separately visible; they are not two permanent specialist types.

mappings.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
mappings.retain: Understand both sides’ original intent and check the integrated result.
mappings.change: Drop never-abort and stage-everything commands. Abort, stop, or ask when that is the safe authorized resolution.

mappings.name: wizard
mappings.retain: Make genuinely human-only setup steps precise, protect secret entry, and avoid repeated explanations.
mappings.change: A guided script is an optional project artifact; do not build one for work the agent can already perform or invent dashboard steps.

mappings.name: grill-me
mappings.retain: Expose explicit stress-testing of a plan or idea.
mappings.change: Alias disappears; the same clarify capability handles explicit grilling and genuine unresolved intent.

mappings.name: grilling
mappings.retain: Ask currently answerable independent decisions with recommendations; facts are investigated, not sent back as questions.
mappings.change: Bound the interview to the next useful outcome. Do not require every conceivable branch to be settled before any progress.

mappings.name: handoff
mappings.retain: Preserve next-session purpose and pointers rather than copy existing specs and diffs.
mappings.change: Choose storage by the transfer’s lifetime; do not assume an OS temp file survives a remote or later session.

mappings.name: teach
mappings.retain: Explain in relevant increments with sources and representations that support understanding.
mappings.change: Multi-session curricula, retrieval exercises, learning records, shared lesson assets, and community referrals are optional separate work, not coding-stack requirements.

mappings.name: to-questionnaire
mappings.retain: Prepare a concise questionnaire for the person who holds missing facts or decisions.
mappings.change: This is clarify’s external-recipient branch; no need for another registered skill or a compulsory deadline estimate.

mappings.name: wait-what
mappings.retain: Reframe a confusing answer in shared domain language.
mappings.change: Same destination as bro; no separate correction command or mandatory STE vocabulary.

mappings.name: writing-for-agents
mappings.retain: Write trigger-oriented pointers, conditional references, clear completion criteria, and one home per meaning.
mappings.change: Remove unmeasured universal claims about negation or specific leading words. Prefer behavior tests over arguing whether wording is a no-op.

mappings.name: git-guardrails-claude-code
mappings.retain: Prefer host permissions or checks for dangerous operations instead of relying only on instructions.
mappings.change: We specify the desired restriction but do not implement a hook runtime here. Regex command matching is not presented as a complete security boundary.

mappings.name: migrate-to-shoehorn
mappings.retain: Use an explicit migration scope and meaningful test data rather than lying about types.
mappings.change: No mandatory @total-typescript/shoehorn dependency or library-specific migration skill. A requested migration uses plan and implement.

mappings.name: scaffold-exercises
mappings.retain: Reusable generation and validation can reduce repetitive work.
mappings.change: The course directory format and ai-hero-cli rules are unrelated to the core; implement a local generator only for a project that needs it.

mappings.name: setup-pre-commit
mappings.retain: Make formatting, typing, and tests executable through the project’s existing checks.
mappings.change: No mandatory Husky, npm, Prettier defaults, or full test suite on every local commit.

mappings.name: claude-handoff
mappings.retain: Pass a concise task state to an actual fresh agent when explicitly requested and supported.
mappings.change: Do not hardcode claude --bg, claim a background launch from a saved file, or treat this experimental skill as a mature runtime.

mappings.name: implement-spec
mappings.retain: Treat tickets as a dependency graph, isolate implementers, and integrate their changes before final review.
mappings.change: The merger responsibility stays with lead plus integrate; no separate merger agent definition or unlimited concurrency.

mappings.name: loop-me
mappings.retain: Clarify a recurring workflow’s trigger, output, and genuine human checkpoints.
mappings.change: No generic life-automation platform. The useful code-maintenance case is a bounded optimize invocation whose schedule the host owns.

mappings.name: retro
mappings.retain: Improve navigation, checks, standards, tool use, and information access from actual session failures.
mappings.change: Do not defer every quality standard to review: small preventative guidance can belong in implementer. Keep reviewer detail out of its context unless needed.

mappings.name: setup-ts-deep-modules
mappings.retain: Enforce useful module boundaries mechanically and demonstrate pass, intentional violation, then restored pass.
mappings.change: No mandatory dependency-cruiser, package layout, tests-through-one-seam rule, or example package. Project needs choose the enforcement.

mappings.name: writing-beats
mappings.retain: Introduce concepts before relying on them and structure explanation as meaningful steps.
mappings.change: No required beat-by-beat interview or exact paragraph-growth procedure in the engineering core.

mappings.name: writing-fragments
mappings.retain: Separate open-ended idea/material generation from committing to a final structure.
mappings.change: No dedicated writing workspace or append-only fragment format in core.

mappings.name: writing-shape
mappings.retain: Turn selected material into a coherent explanation while preserving the author’s edits.
mappings.change: No mandatory paragraph-by-paragraph approval loop or separate writing command.

mappings.name: show-me
mappings.retain: Choose the smallest useful visual explanation, from code shape to a focused HTML artifact.
mappings.change: Do not generate an elaborate canvas when a short explanation answers the question.

mappings.name: narrow-react-prop-types
mappings.retain: Make component types reflect supported states and live callers rather than broad speculative shapes.
mappings.change: React-specific details stay in the language/framework reference; test convenience does not define the production API.

mappings.name: improve-claude-md
mappings.retain: Use clear conditional applicability to make relevant instructions easier to follow.
mappings.change: The <important if> syntax is a candidate presentation technique, not a universal requirement or new policy primitive.

mappings.name: design-control-loop
mappings.retain: Define target, observation, next bounded action, validation, and feedback; prove the pieces locally first.
mappings.change: Keep the control-loop questions in a playbook reference. No sensor/controller/actuator categories, scheduler, or CI runtime in the framework.

mappings.name: build-iterated-agentic-loop
mappings.retain: A task-specific skill and persistent feedback can support repeated bounded improvements.
mappings.change: A scheduled workflow and headless runner are optional project implementation, not deliverables of this Markdown design.

mappings.name: improve-claude-md
mappings.retain: The same conditional-instruction technique also published under HumanLayer.
mappings.change: One destination and one procedure; record both provenances without double-counting the mechanism.

mappings.name: html-presentations
mappings.retain: Use a visual artifact when a presentation is the appropriate way to communicate.
mappings.change: No prescribed presentation theme, slide mechanics, or full presentation builder in core.

mappings.name: clean-coder
mappings.retain: User frustration signals that the current approach may need correction and stronger evidence.
mappings.change: No profanity-triggered quality mode, shaming, or performative persona. Good diagnosis and candor apply before the user becomes frustrated.

mappings.name: ci_commit
mappings.retain: Make focused commits from the actual session diff with explicit paths.
mappings.change: Unattended behavior follows existing authority, not a separate commit command. No blanket ban on useful tests or project notes.

mappings.name: ci_describe_pr
mappings.retain: Describe the real change and only mark performed checks complete.
mappings.change: Share the same description procedure as interactive use; remove thoughts-sync dependencies.

mappings.name: commit
mappings.retain: Group logical changes and obtain necessary commit authority.
mappings.change: One commit procedure, not separate interactive/CI versions. Attribution follows user/project policy rather than a hardcoded no-AI-credit rule.

mappings.name: create_handoff
mappings.retain: Capture task status, decisions, references, artifacts, and next steps.
mappings.change: Remove personal paths, tracker prefixes, large compulsory metadata templates, and thoughts sync.

mappings.name: create_plan
mappings.retain: Ground phases and success criteria in code and user decisions; distinguish executed checks from human acceptance.
mappings.change: No mandatory full-file rereading of everything, fixed phase sequence, or human pause after every phase.

mappings.name: create_plan_generic
mappings.retain: Use the same research-backed planning procedure without repository-specific dependencies.
mappings.change: No generic variant file; local conventions are read rather than hardcoded.

mappings.name: create_plan_nt
mappings.retain: Planning need not depend on a thoughts repository.
mappings.change: No no-thoughts variant. The project chooses an artifact location once.

mappings.name: create_worktree
mappings.retain: Establish an isolated implementation workspace with an explicit plan and branch.
mappings.change: No humanlayer launcher, home-directory convention, or automatic external action beyond the request.

mappings.name: debug
mappings.retain: Inspect actual logs, database state, and git history without assuming the cause.
mappings.change: Remove HumanLayer’s paths, table names, and service names. Respect the distinction between observing and mutating runtime state.

mappings.name: describe_pr
mappings.retain: Use the project template and real diff to explain purpose, user impact, and verification.
mappings.change: No duplicate generic/CI variants or compulsory synced description file.

mappings.name: describe_pr_nt
mappings.retain: Generate the same grounded PR description without a thoughts store.
mappings.change: One procedure; storage is an existing project convention.

mappings.name: founder_mode
mappings.retain: Bring an existing exploratory change into a clear branch/PR record.
mappings.change: Do not blindly switch main and cherry-pick a remembered commit. Inspect actual state and preserve uncommitted work first.

mappings.name: implement_plan
mappings.retain: Execute approved units, adapt to genuine mismatches, and distinguish automated from human verification.
mappings.change: The delivery owner handles phase transitions and human decisions. Do not require a manual pause for every phase or trust old checkmarks unconditionally.

mappings.name: iterate_plan
mappings.retain: Make focused evidence-backed updates to a plan while preserving settled decisions and unrelated sections.
mappings.change: No separate planning-edit skill or repeated generic confirmation when the user already requested the specific update.

mappings.name: iterate_plan_nt
mappings.retain: The same plan revision without thoughts synchronization.
mappings.change: No duplicated no-thoughts workflow.

mappings.name: linear
mappings.retain: Preserve the actual problem, meaningful dispositions, source links, and existing tracker conventions.
mappings.change: Remove organization IDs, personal names, fixed statuses, default assignees, and hidden write authority.

mappings.name: local_review
mappings.retain: Review another branch in an isolated, explicitly identified workspace.
mappings.change: Do not copy credentials or local settings blindly, or assume the humanlayer repository and setup commands.

mappings.name: oneshot
mappings.retain: Compose research, planning, and subsequent implementation with usable context.
mappings.change: Remove permission-bypass flags, a fixed launcher/model, and simulated fresh-session execution.

mappings.name: oneshot_plan
mappings.retain: Compose planning and implementation without rewriting either procedure.
mappings.change: Implementation starts only within the original authority and when the plan is sufficiently ready.

mappings.name: ralph_impl
mappings.retain: Select one eligible ready unit, preserve its plan context, and implement in isolation.
mappings.change: Eligibility comes from the project; no hardcoded top-ten priority query, SMALL/XS requirement, or auto-bypass runner.

mappings.name: ralph_plan
mappings.retain: Select an eligible planning item, use its existing research, and record readiness honestly.
mappings.change: Use the same planning procedure and existing tracker status vocabulary, not a new recurring planner type.

mappings.name: ralph_research
mappings.retain: Investigate one eligible item and attach usable evidence before advancing it.
mappings.change: Bounded queue processing belongs to the caller; do not create a polling or scheduling system.

mappings.name: research_codebase
mappings.retain: Separate as-is documentation from critique, use parallel discovery when useful, and cite actual code.
mappings.change: No unconditional full-context reading or separate thought-directory implementation. Investigating does not silently authorize redesign.

mappings.name: research_codebase_generic
mappings.retain: The same source-grounded investigation in a generic project.
mappings.change: One research capability; no generic variant.

mappings.name: research_codebase_nt
mappings.retain: As-is research without a specific notes store.
mappings.change: One research capability; no no-thoughts variant.

mappings.name: resume_handoff
mappings.retain: Read the saved state and reconcile it with current code before continuing.
mappings.change: Avoid both blind trust and mandatory full revalidation of every historical detail; focus on what changed and what the next action depends on.

mappings.name: validate_plan
mappings.retain: Check implementation against the intended outcomes and execute the declared checks.
mappings.change: Review judges correspondence; verify produces observations. Checkmarks and summaries alone are not evidence.

mappings.name: codebase-analyzer
mappings.retain: Trace implementation and data flow with precise references.
mappings.change: Remove repetitive personality prose; descriptive research does not become unsolicited critique.

mappings.name: codebase-locator
mappings.retain: Find and categorize relevant files and entry points.
mappings.change: Location finding shares scout with other retrieval sources; no separate agent for each data store.

mappings.name: codebase-pattern-finder
mappings.retain: Find concrete implementation and testing examples already present.
mappings.change: Show the actual pattern without claiming it must be copied or is the best design.

mappings.name: thoughts-analyzer
mappings.retain: Extract consequential decisions and constraints while checking age and relevance.
mappings.change: Keep rejected alternatives when their rationale matters; do not automatically filter away the evidence needed to avoid repeating them.

mappings.name: thoughts-locator
mappings.retain: Find relevant historical documents and preserve accurate editable paths.
mappings.change: A notes location is project information, not a separate thoughts agent type.

mappings.name: web-search-researcher
mappings.retain: Use attributable, current, high-trust sources and state gaps.
mappings.change: Search stays scout work; complex source synthesis goes to analyst. No enthusiastic persona or mandatory background agent.

mappings.name: poteto-agent
mappings.retain: Initialize the working style and relevant shared guidance before substantive work.
mappings.change: Remove the requirement to wrap all tasks in a sticky personal subagent. The main lead and scoped workers read their own role instructions.

mappings.name: Comment Sicko
mappings.retain: Spot comments hiding poor structure and preserve API, legal, and external-constraint information.
mappings.change: Keep comments and suppression scrutiny without theatrical voice or delete-on-doubt. reviewer produces findings; simplifier changes the structure or comments while preserving otherwise-lost rationale and safety obligations.

mappings.name: how: explorer / explainer
mappings.retain: Separate broad retrieval from a coherent mechanism explanation.
mappings.change: No new role for each investigation angle.

mappings.name: why: per-source investigators / synthesizer
mappings.retain: Keep source-specific evidence gathering and final confidence-aware synthesis distinct.
mappings.change: One scout role may be instantiated per relevant source; analyst handles cross-source causal interpretation.

mappings.name: arena: candidates / cross-judge / lead picker
mappings.retain: Separate artifact generation, independent comparison, and final selection.
mappings.change: The artifact task selects its role and configured model. swarm compare owns the reusable candidate/judge procedure; no arena-agent type or new routing service.

mappings.name: swarm: coverage workers / race arms
mappings.retain: State coverage or selection criteria, collect outcomes, and expose dropouts.
mappings.change: Partition and compare remain distinct modes in one reusable skill. Every writer gets a separate worktree. Task type, not cloud/local placement or swarm membership, determines the role.

mappings.name: reflect: judgment / tooling / divergent / synthesizer
mappings.retain: Look at substantive judgment, tool use, and missed approaches before proposing durable guidance.
mappings.change: Reviewer handles judgment/divergent critiques, analyst handles tooling evidence, and lead reconciles. No mandatory four-agent cascade.

mappings.name: poteto-mode: communication and subagent supervision
mappings.retain: Own the returned work, keep communication readable, and relay consolidated scope.
mappings.change: Put supervision and single-writer logging in lead/common instructions. Role definitions hold model choices; procedures use them without runtime routing infrastructure.

mappings.name: poteto-mode: autonomy and approvals
mappings.retain: Distinguish delegated execution from retained human decisions.
mappings.change: Reversible external writes are not automatically authorized; user stop and scope restrictions remain active.

mappings.name: poteto-mode: prose conventions
mappings.retain: Clear consumer-focused explanations with real links.
mappings.change: The original punctuation and personality constraints are not global engineering rules.

mappings.name: orchestrate: coordinator / sub-coordinator
mappings.retain: One accountable owner decomposes work and reconciles progress.
mappings.change: A sub-coordinator, when genuinely useful, is a bounded instance of lead; no mandatory hierarchy or controller software.

mappings.name: orchestrate: worker / verifier
mappings.retain: Separate production work from checking the resulting artifact.
mappings.change: Use fixed task-appropriate implementation definitions and verifier. Separate worktrees and explicit artifacts remain; no custom cloud hierarchy or scheduler.

mappings.name: orchestrate: stacker
mappings.retain: Centralize shared-branch and topology changes.
mappings.change: No dedicated stacker definition or Graphite requirement. Lead owns canonical operations; implementer resolves semantic conflicts.

mappings.name: orchestrate: watcher / retro watcher
mappings.retain: Recheck live outcomes and notice post-merge problems when follow-through is requested.
mappings.change: Not a permanent agent role. Existing host waiting or a truthful checkpoint replaces a custom watcher runtime.

mappings.name: autopilot: per-PR owner / root verifier
mappings.retain: Keep accountability for each change and independent pre-landing checks.
mappings.change: Task ownership does not require a new role or give every worker merge permission.

mappings.name: Benny: poster / code worker / media reviewer
mappings.retain: Keep external posting in one owner and verify that media actually shows the reported symptom.
mappings.change: Narrow credentials through the host when possible. A prose ban alone is not credential isolation.

mappings.name: correctness
mappings.retain: Review logic, state, error propagation, and intent.
mappings.change: Intent/correctness section; always relevant when reviewing substantive behavior.

mappings.name: project-standards
mappings.retain: Apply the project’s documented conventions with citations.
mappings.change: Standards section; do not re-review formatting already enforced by tooling.

mappings.name: testing
mappings.retain: Assess whether tests observe meaningful behavior and can catch the relevant defects.
mappings.change: Testing section; not a separate tester personality.

mappings.name: maintainability
mappings.retain: Assess abstraction, coupling, ownership, and structural change.
mappings.change: Structure section, shared with thermonuclear review and deep-module guidance.

mappings.name: agent-native
mappings.retain: Review agent-facing prompts, tools, and feature accessibility.
mappings.change: Agent-instructions section; select only for an agent-facing contract.

mappings.name: learnings
mappings.retain: Find existing project learning relevant to the change.
mappings.change: Retrieval, not an independent review judgment; analyst resolves contradictions.

mappings.name: security
mappings.retain: Assess trust boundaries, authorization, inputs, and sensitive data.
mappings.change: Security section; source details stay with the project.

mappings.name: performance
mappings.retain: Assess concrete workload and resource risks.
mappings.change: Performance section; verifier/optimize supplies measurements rather than a speculative verdict.

mappings.name: api-contract
mappings.retain: Review changes to an actually consumed external contract.
mappings.change: Compatibility section; an internal export does not automatically need this pass.

mappings.name: data-migration
mappings.retain: Assess migration/backfill correctness and compatibility.
mappings.change: Migration section; not automatically selected for any query or ORM edit.

mappings.name: reliability
mappings.retain: Assess retries, partial failure, ordering, and lifecycle behavior.
mappings.change: Reliability section; use realistic failure scenarios.

mappings.name: adversarial
mappings.retain: Challenge assumptions independently.
mappings.change: A separately configured reviewer-second provides the independent additional model. Retain risk-based selection and fresh context, not a new peer execution controller.

mappings.name: previous-comments
mappings.retain: Reconcile prior findings with the current revision.
mappings.change: Prior-feedback section only when prior feedback exists; old claims are not automatically still valid.

mappings.name: julik-frontend-races
mappings.retain: Inspect asynchronous UI ordering and lifecycle races.
mappings.change: UI-lifecycle section; framework-specific examples stay conditional, not another named person’s role.

mappings.name: swift-ios
mappings.retain: Inspect native platform and lifecycle correctness.
mappings.change: Platform section; simulator execution belongs to verifier.

mappings.name: deployment-verification-agent
mappings.retain: Prepare migration rollout checks and rollback considerations.
mappings.change: Reviewer assesses the plan; verifier executes permitted checks. Neither label grants production deployment authority.

mappings.name: simplify: reuse / quality / efficiency reviewers
mappings.retain: Assess reuse, structural quality, and actual efficiency independently when useful.
mappings.change: Use the dedicated simplifier model for the normal structural pass. Reviewer lenses remain selectable criteria, not three compulsory agents for every cleanup.

mappings.name: work: host orchestrator / implementation workers
mappings.retain: Host retains canonical integration while scoped workers return actual changes and checks.
mappings.change: Separate implementation assignments for mechanical, ordinary, and difficult tasks using named agent definitions. Lead keeps canonical integration and the entire merge-ready tail; no runtime engine registry.

mappings.name: review-feedback: central evaluator / fixers
mappings.retain: Judge legitimacy before dispatching fixes and keep unresolved decisions explicit.
mappings.change: Fixers are implementer instances, not another permanent role.

mappings.name: plan/brainstorm: grounding scouts / claim verifier
mappings.retain: Separate retrieval, design synthesis, and empirical confirmation.
mappings.change: A claim verifier is verifier only when observing the claim; source-based assessment belongs to analyst/reviewer.

mappings.name: POV: independent position / peer reconciliation
mappings.retain: Form a view before seeing peer opinions and reconcile against evidence.
mappings.change: Use existing roles and configured models; no separate oracle role or claim that a panel guarantees correctness. The optional alternatives entry point handles an explicit rethink of an existing system; normal architectural alternatives remain inside design.

mappings.name: compound: research helpers / canonical writer
mappings.retain: Gather evidence without multiple agents racing to edit persistent knowledge.
mappings.change: Lead owns the canonical learning edit; no distinct curator role.

mappings.group: Matt Pocock / embedded responsibilities and artifacts
mappings.name: code-review: Standards / Spec
mappings.retain: Keep conformance and requirements coverage visibly separate.
mappings.change: Two calls of one reviewer role, or two clearly separated passes; no two additional agent types.

mappings.group: Matt Pocock / embedded responsibilities and artifacts
mappings.name: implement-spec: explorer / implementer / merger
mappings.retain: Pass context to independent work units and reconcile their real results.
mappings.change: Merger becomes lead-owned integrate. Preserve experimental status of the source.

mappings.group: Matt Pocock / embedded responsibilities and artifacts
mappings.name: wayfinder: research / prototype / grilling / prerequisite task
mappings.retain: Different unresolved questions need different kinds of work, including genuine human decisions.
mappings.change: These are task kinds that call existing skills, not new roles or a second workflow engine.

mappings.group: Matt Pocock / embedded responsibilities and artifacts
mappings.name: domain-modeling: glossary / context map / ADR
mappings.retain: Separate meanings from consequential implementation choices and support multiple genuine domain contexts.
mappings.change: Create a context map only when real context boundaries justify it; no mandatory tree of documents.

mappings.group: Matt Pocock / embedded responsibilities and artifacts
mappings.name: writing-for-agents: invocation and router mechanics
mappings.retain: Trigger metadata is agent-facing; manual-only commands are not callable dependencies of other skills.
mappings.change: Keep description-as-trigger and invocation distinctions. Only setup and rewrite are manual-only; automatic workflows cannot bypass those boundaries. compound is model-invokable but persistent inferred changes remain approval-gated.

mappings.name: control loop: set point
mappings.retain: Name the desired condition and the scope in which improvement is allowed.
mappings.change: A field in the task plan, not another framework concept.

mappings.name: control loop: sensor
mappings.retain: Observe current state through a useful repeatable measure.
mappings.change: A check or project command, not a new agent type.

mappings.name: control loop: controller
mappings.retain: Choose the next bounded increment from the actual gap.
mappings.change: Instructions in optimize, not a controller implementation.

mappings.name: control loop: actuator
mappings.retain: Apply an owned bounded change through the local task procedure.
mappings.change: An implementer using a skill, not an actuator primitive.

mappings.name: control loop: disturbances / dampener / feedback
mappings.retain: Account for concurrent change, optional regression checks, and standing feedback.
mappings.change: Use existing checks and project notes; a schedule lives in the host rather than this framework.

mappings.name: Advanced context engineering
mappings.retain: Separate research, planning, and execution when doing so protects useful context; carry distilled evidence between phases.
mappings.change: No universal token threshold, mandatory phase reset, or promise that compaction alone solves design quality.

mappings.name: Why software factories fail
mappings.retain: Keep human understanding and program design visible rather than assume more loops replace them.
mappings.change: Treat the broader argument as a philosophical caution, not proof that all unattended development must fail.

user_decisions.title: More granular role/model assignments
user_decisions.decision: Keep the original seven roles and add implementer-fast, implementer-deep, simplifier, reviewer-second, and auditor. The exact names are a concrete design choice implementing the approved finer-grained control.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Keep the approved consolidations
user_decisions.decision: One clarify skill composes domain modeling. Feature, repair, and refactor remain branches of deliver. Specification, implementation planning, and any requested tickets remain in plan.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Separate ideation from architecture
user_decisions.decision: ideate has its own pipeline. design still considers alternatives as part of shaping an architecture.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Offer an explicit rethink of an existing system
user_decisions.decision: Include alternatives as a standalone report-only entry point because the user raised it as potentially useful. Do not make it a mandatory phase or imply they demanded a redesign of every system.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Keep a reusable arena/swarm operation
user_decisions.decision: One model-invokable swarm skill supports manual invocation and composition, with distinct partition and compare modes.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Default to structural improvement
user_decisions.decision: Permit and prefer a coherent root-cause refactor or redesign over a smaller patch when it better fulfills the same requirements. A substantive change gets a simplification assessment and fresh review, including reassessment after material iteration churn.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Experiment with a from-scratch PR rewrite
user_decisions.decision: rewrite freezes the original, reconstructs semantic and operational goals, builds from the target base in a fresh context/worktree, independently compares and verifies, and preserves the original. It is never auto-invoked. One rewrite is the starting experiment, not a compulsory two-or-three-draft ritual.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Complete implementation through merge-ready
user_decisions.decision: Starting delivery carries through implementation, structural improvement, review/fix, pushes/PR, CI and feedback, and final audit. Stop at merge-ready, never merge or arm auto-merge by default. Explicit narrower endpoints still apply.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Keep one log and publish a confidence-graded decision audit
user_decisions.decision: Single canonical log with one writer, separate worktrees for simultaneous agents, independent evidence audit, and a durable artifact on the PR. TSV columns and repository-hosted publication are proposed concrete defaults, not claims of verbatim user instructions.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026

user_decisions.title: Rename maintain to model-invokable compound
user_decisions.decision: Model invocation can inspect/propose learning. Apply a direct explicit instruction to change a skill/rule without another approval; inferred persistent instruction edits wait for approval. learn stays focused on project knowledge.
user_decisions.source: User review feedback in this conversation, September 9, 2026
